topic: A tiny portable immediate-mode UI library in ANSI C that turns per-frame input into rectangle and text draw commands
audience: a C developer new to immediate-mode UI
analogy: a short-order diner kitchen that throws away the ticket and re-takes your whole order on every visit
why: A single frame's journey from input to draw commands shows the immediate-mode idea best, and overview depth is enough for this tiny tool to be understood and used.
